steps.title: Ask the undisclosed lender for an estoppel letter
steps.draft:
DRAFT LETTER — Ask the undisclosed lender for an estoppel letter
To: Harbor Capital Partners LP (secured party of record)
Re: Facility monitoring — request for information (B0062)

As part of our routine monitoring of the facility, we have identified items we need to reconcile:
  - 'Harbor Capital Partners LP' holds a lien on a related company ('Ironwood Receivables LLC': all assets of the debtor) that the borrower never disclosed [ref S5-B0062-COMPETING_LIEN-a39fbd57]
  - Debt reported to Wells Fargo omits 1 secured lender(s) found in public lien filings [ref S7-B0062-DEBT_GAP-bc5ca1ff]
  - Judgment of $10,621,442 against 'Ironwood Receivables LLC' in favour of Harbor Capital Partners LP [ref S5-B0062-JUDGMENT-adab8f53]

Please provide an estoppel letter stating the amount outstanding, the collateral you hold, and the borrower entities obligated by 2026-09-16.

This letter requests information to reconcile our records. It does not allege wrongdoing by any party.

[Credit officer], Wells Fargo
